churches.assessment: Aldersgate Church in Lubbock was founded in 1985 when a preacher began knocking on doors inviting people to a new church experience — the first service was held August 4, 1985 in the gymnasium of All Saints Episcopal School. The congregation voted 97% to disaffiliate from the UMC and has joined the Global Methodist Church. Lead Pastor Ryan Smallwood (married to Amy, two adult sons Blake and Jeb) leads with a conversational teaching style. Notable: Emily Fisher serves as Next Gen Pastor, meaning women do serve in pastoral roles at this particular local church — a YELLOW flag on the gender rubric for readers committed to strictly male-only pastoral offices. The lopsided disaffiliation vote signals strong institutional orthodox commitment, however. Named for John Wesley's famous May 1738 Aldersgate Street conversion experience.

churches.assessment: Christ Methodist Church of Auburn is a post-2022 Global Methodist plant, having voted to join the GMC and called Dr. Tony McCullough as their first senior minister in 2023. Nearly 700 members stood together at their first membership vows ceremony. The congregation currently gathers at the Greystone Office and Ministry Center while actively exploring permanent building options. As a GMC church, they affirm orthodox Wesleyan theology, traditional marriage, and the historic Christian faith — the specific reasons the GMC separated from the progressive UMC. Male lead pastor, active men's Bible study, and children's ministry make this a strong Methodist option for the Auburn area. The one caution flag is that the GMC's Alabama-Florida-West Georgia Conference ordination stance on women as elders should be verified; GMC varies by conference. Overall a green-eligible, solidly orthodox Wesleyan church worth further on-the-ground review.

churches.assessment: First Methodist Church of Waco is a historic 1859 congregation that was among the earliest to leave the UMC and join the Global Methodist Church in 2022. Rev. Dr. Mike Voigts became Senior Pastor in May 2025 after serving as a professor at Asbury Theological Seminary — bringing academic Wesleyan depth to the pulpit. The church operates three campuses: the Main Campus on Cobbs Drive, the Speegleville Campus, and a Baylor Campus specifically reaching university students with a Tuesday 7 PM service. One flag worth noting: Rev. Dr. Blossom Matthews serves as Senior Associate Pastor, meaning this particular GMC church does appoint women to pastoral roles (distinct from formal elder ordination, which varies by conference). This places the church closer to the YELLOW end of the gender-rubric for readers committed to male-only ordination. For those comfortable with women in teaching/associate roles but male senior leadership, it's a solid orthodox Wesleyan option in Central Texas.

churches.assessment: Mt. Bethel Church Marietta GA is one of the most prominent post-UMC independent megachurches. Senior Pastor Dr. Jody Ray (since 2016) was reassigned by UMC Bishop Sue Haupert-Johnson in 2021; he surrendered his UMC clergy credentials in protest, the congregation gathered ~4,700 signatures, and the church ultimately paid ~$13.1M in a 2022 settlement to leave the UMC with property. Importantly, Mt. Bethel did NOT join the GMC — it operates as an independent Methodist congregation. ~10,000 members, 2,300+ avg attendance. The pastor's and congregation's deliberate stand against UMC progressive leadership is theologically substantive. Yellow denominational reflects post-schism independence with no connectional accountability — the autonomy is sometimes a weakness, sometimes a strength.

churches.assessment: Mt. Horeb Church in Lexington, SC was South Carolina's largest United Methodist congregation before a dramatic 97% congregational vote on February 26, 2023 to leave the UMC, with formal GMC membership finalized in August 2023. Senior Pastor Jeff Kersey has led through this transition. The church runs two campuses (East traditional, West contemporary) with four services total each Sunday morning, and emphasizes making, maturing, and mobilizing disciples. Like all post-2022 GMC churches, the institutional commitment to orthodoxy (evidenced by the costly decision to leave UMC property and structure) is the strongest signal — these are congregations that paid a price to preserve biblical teaching on marriage and Christian doctrine. The GMC South Carolina Conference position on women as elders should be verified; otherwise this is a solidly orthodox Wesleyan option in the Columbia metro area.

churches.assessment: Resurrection Global Methodist Church is a young church plant established in September 2022 — essentially co-founded with the GMC denomination itself. Pastor Jason Nix came on as Lead Pastor in May 2023 with 15+ years of ministry experience. The congregation currently gathers at the Arlington Music Hall while establishing itself. As a brand-new GMC plant rather than a transitioned former UMC congregation, this church's identity is defined entirely by orthodox Wesleyan doctrine from inception — no legacy progressivism to unwind. The caution is typical GMC ambiguity on gender/elder policy (verify Mid Texas Conference stance) and the reality that small young plants often have less-developed men's ministries. Still, a green-eligible option for readers seeking a post-UMC-split orthodox Wesleyan church in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro.

churches.assessment: The Woodlands Methodist Church is the single largest church in the Global Methodist Church — 14,000 members who voted 96% to depart the UMC and join the GMC in 2023. That kind of institutional courage (leaving a denomination with all the attendant property and legal costs) signals a congregation serious about orthodox Wesleyan teaching. Rev. Mark Sorensen took over as Senior Pastor from the long-tenured Rev. Dr. Ed Robb in 2021, holds an M.Div from Asbury Theological Seminary, and has served the church since 2013. The church operates two campuses in the Houston suburbs, runs a preschool and a private elementary school, and offers 10 live and online worship services weekly. As with all GMC churches, the local stance on women as elders should be verified (the Texas conference varies), but the overall profile is solidly orthodox, Trinitarian, traditional-marriage Wesleyan.
